notes: Replication source is the updated preprint "No Evidence for the Affective Expectation Model: Replication of Geers and Lassiter (2003)" hosted in the assigned OSF project; project link and Study 1 verified. Original source is the full author-uploaded article HTML. Original analytic n left null: participant composition is printed but no explicit analytic total. The p. 318 original target is the one-df positive-versus-control interaction (r² = .04, p = .01); the paper separately reports the two-df added-interaction block on p. 317 (p = .04), which is a different test. Replication reports the two-df omnibus interaction, as in its p. 16 target table; this operational test difference is retained. Printed replication η² < 0.01 is secondary; requested F is extracted.
